uncertain: Total required credits for the major is not explicitly stated in the document; it must be calculated by summing required and elective credits, but the elective allows choice among courses, so the total may vary.

The note in the Elective(s) group mentions 'Courses taken to fulfili the Option Requirements may not be reused to count towards this elective requirement', which implies a restriction that may affect course selection if a student pursues an option, but this is not enforced in the course list.

The document references 'Option(s)' and includes the Accounting Analytics Option, but it is unclear whether completing an option is mandatory or optional for graduation; the text says 'Students may opt to graduate with or without an option', so the option is optional, but the requirement tree includes it as a group anyway.

The course ISOM3400 appears in both the Elective(s) group and the Accounting Analytics Option Required Course(s) group; if a student takes the option, they cannot reuse ISOM3400 for the elective, but the JSON currently lists it in both places without indicating mutual exclusivity.

total_required_credits (28.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file. The PDF does not state a single overall minimum total for this program, so this figure is derived by summation and may double-count where optional tracks/options are listed as separate groups.
